messages:
Alex D: Heads-up — support ticket from Acme: burst of 401s + duplicate billing events after yesterday's cross-sdk regen. They upgraded python client to v0.12.0 and started seeing retries and inflated token counts. Link to ticket: https://support.example/ACME-2345 :grimacing:

Sara S: ugh, those billing duplicates sound like double-send retries. Any logs from their side?

Alex D: pasted minimal repro logs they attached: 
```
2026-03-09T14:02:11Z ERROR request failed status=401 body={"error":"unauthorized"}
2026-03-09T14:02:11Z DEBUG retrying request attempt=2 cause=status_401
2026-03-09T14:02:11Z INFO request sent tokens=54
```
They say the headers include `X-Client-Version` in older clients but v0.12.0 doesn't set it.

Mike (SDK): interesting — our regen removed a default header mapping when we switched the generator template (openapi 2026-03-08). If `X-Client-Version` was being used by auth proxy to select a JWT audience, missing header could cause auth fallback and 401 then SDK retries. Which SDKs were rolled?

Alex D: python v0.12.0 and ts 1.4.0 were published yesterday; they upgraded python. Go not affected yet.

Jen I (infra): ops-bot shows increased 401s from that customer around publish time. I can see proxy logs that treat requests without `X-Client-Version` as legacy and route to a different auth flow that returns 401 and increments billing meter — bug.

Tim B (build): quick check: CI regen job changed templating for header defaults: `header_defaults: {}` got flattened. I can revert generator change and produce a patch release. Repro steps I used locally: 
```
# reproduce with python client
pip install redwood-sdk==0.12.0
python -c "from redwood import Client; c=Client(); c.text.generate('hi')"
# watch network with tcpdump or envoy logs
```

Sara S: for the customer immediate mitigation: advise pinning to v0.11.9 and set header manually: 
```
client = Client(headers={"X-Client-Version":"py-0.11.9"})
```

Mike (SDK): agree. Also adding a config toggle so SDK doesn't retry on 401 by default would stop duplicate billing while we investigate. I'll open a PR.

Jen I (infra): I'll add a temporary routing rule: if missing header, route to fallback but return 403 instead of 401 for now so client doesn't retry automatically. Ops change with canary 2%.

Alex D: I'll tell the customer to pin and apply header patch, and that we're doing a canary rollback. Thanks. 

Tim B (build): action items: 1) revert generator template and cut 0.12.1; 2) add test in regen CI to assert header_defaults preserved; 3) SDK change to disable retry-on-401. I'll own 1+2.

Mike (SDK): I'll branch for disabling retry-on-401 and add a changelog note (breaking behavioral change) — will coordinate with PM for release.

ops-bot: Incident annotated: incident/ACME-2345 created, severity=P2, linked to deploy/job/regen-2026-03-08.

Sara S: thanks all — I'll update the support ticket and the customer. Please post PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
